name: Swahid Kushal Konwar Sarbajanin Briddha Pension Achoni
benefit: The beneficiary will be granted a sum of ₹ 250/- per month through DBT. The pension amount will be remitted on the first day of every month to the account of the beneficiary.
eligibility_rules: The scheme is meant for the residents of the State of Assam, who are 60 years or above in age.
Beneficiaries of any of the existing government schemes. Parents of children (where the latter is employed with the government).Any taxpayer who earns an income of above ₹ 2,50,000/-.
exclusions: Beneficiaries of any of the existing government schemes. Parents of children (where the latter is employed with the government).Any taxpayer who earns an income of above ₹ 2,50,000/-.

AssamDetails of the Aadhaar Linked Bank Account
